name: according to
example: According to the weather report, it will rain today.

name: because of
example: The match was cancelled because of the rain.

name: due to
example: The flight was delayed due to bad weather.

name: instead of
example: She drank juice instead of coffee.

name: in front of
example: The car is parked in front of the house.

name: next to
example: The hospital is next to the bank.

name: out of
example: We are out of milk.

name: apart from
example: Apart from Ravi, everyone attended.

name: along with
example: She came along with her parents.

name: as for
example: As for me, I agree with the plan.
exampleTamil: என்னைப் பொறுத்தவரை, இந்த திட்டத்தை நான் ஒப்புக்கொள்கிறேன்.

name: as to
example: There is no doubt as to his honesty.
exampleTamil: அவருடைய நேர்மையைப் பற்றி எந்த சந்தேகமும் இல்லை.

name: by means of
example: They communicated by means of gestures.

name: in addition to
example: In addition to English, she speaks Tamil.

name: in spite of
example: He went out in spite of the rain.

name: on behalf of
example: She accepted the award on behalf of her team.
exampleTamil: அவள் தனது குழுவின் சார்பாக விருதைப் பெற்றாள்.

name: with regard to
example: I have a question with regard to your application.
exampleTamil: உங்கள் விண்ணப்பம் தொடர்பாக எனக்கு ஒரு கேள்வி உள்ளது.

name: with respect to
example: The rules changed with respect to attendance.

name: in accordance with
example: The work was completed in accordance with the guidelines.

name: prior to
example: Please register prior to the event.

name: thanks to
example: Thanks to your help, I finished the project.
